svg.title: Vitals — every deployed project on a patient monitor
svg.desc: A bedside-monitor view of 13 deployments, each an ECG channel whose rhythm comes from its latest health check: 1 alarm. Checked from GitHub Actions every 3 hours; last run 12 Nov 2026 10:20 IST. Median response 254 ms; uptime 94.9% across 3 runs since 12 Nov 2026. Kovidam: normal, 236 ms; JKY-Radar: no signal, no response; ShopKart: normal, 290 ms; Chakraview: normal, 194 ms; Multimodal Evidence Console: normal, 204 ms; GitVeda: normal, 282 ms; JKY Terminal · site: normal, 245 ms; Agentra: normal, 963 ms; BloodConnect: normal, 157 ms; AI-ML Club · project ideas: normal, 254 ms; Portfolio: normal, 257 ms; Student-Dost: normal, 211 ms; SoundBoard: normal, 322 ms.
